title: My family visited Berawala Village, Mahajan Firing Field Range (MFFR) (Vlog 0)
description:
I documented the visit to Berawala Village which is one of the 34 Village which is situated in Mahajan Field Firing Ranges (MFFR)

MFFR was acquired in 1984 and are the second-largest Ranges in the country with an area of 3.37 lakh acres of land.

Mahajan Field Firing Ranges have also been designated as the integrated training hub for the conduct of joint exercises with friendly foreign and partner countries which is on the increase as India extends its soft power to South-East Asian, African, and Central Asian Republics.
